author: Storra
description: Find real charity stories a creator could make a video or post about, with the brief and the support on offer. Read-only, no sign-in.
name: Storra for Creators

tools.name: search_stories_to_tell
tools.title: Search stories to tell
tools.description: Search real charity stories a creator could make a video or post about. Matches the query against titles, summaries, charities, causes and places, and returns the best matches with a link to each story page.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "children Manchester" or "animal rescue".

cause.description: Only stories for this cause, e.g. "Health". Use list_causes for the values.

location.description: Only stories in this place, e.g. "Manchester".

limit.description: How many stories to return (default 10, at most 25).

tools.name: get_story
tools.title: Get a story
tools.description: Get one story in full: the story, where you could take it, the support on offer, and the charity's details.

slug.description: The story's slug, from a search result.

tools.name: list_causes
tools.title: List causes
tools.description: List the causes stories are filed under, with how many stories each has. Use a cause as the filter in a search.
